THE PARLOUR / TAKE YOUR TIME

Four Houses

Grow kingdoms but score the weakest of four cultures, using different rules for internal leadership disputes and external wars.

Restart this deal
Another deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Build under opponent leader for board position, increase weakest score rather than strongest, start internal coup cheaply or prepare costly external war, keep matching hand cards for support instead of placing for immediate points.

Take a seat
How to play
6×6 land/river board; four tile colors and four leader types per side. Turn two actions: place tile from six-card hand (river color only on river), place/move a leader adjacent to shrine tile, or exchange the entire hand. Tile added to kingdom awards point of its color to same-color leader owner if present. Moving second same-color leader into existing kingdom triggers internal contest using adjacent shrines plus committed shrine hand tiles; loser leader removed. Connecting separate kingdoms containing rival same-color leaders triggers external contest using total matching-color tiles plus committed matching hand cards; loser leader and losing-color tiles removed, potentially splitting kingdom. Tied strength favors defender; commitments simultaneous.
After 24 full turns or tile bag depleted, sort four scores ascending and compare lexicographically; higher weakest then next weakest wins. Equal draws.
Canal tiles occupy river only; all other tiles occupy land. Exchange replaces your entire hand and costs one action. Tile placement pays after any conflict resolves.

How to play
6×6 land/river board; four tile colors and four leader types per side. Turn two actions: place tile from six-card hand (river color only on river), place/move a leader adjacent to shrine tile, or exchange the entire hand. Tile added to kingdom awards point of its color to same-color leader owner if present. Moving second same-color leader into existing kingdom triggers internal contest using adjacent shrines plus committed shrine hand tiles; loser leader removed. Connecting separate kingdoms containing rival same-color leaders triggers external contest using total matching-color tiles plus committed matching hand cards; loser leader and losing-color tiles removed, potentially splitting kingdom. Tied strength favors defender; commitments simultaneous.
After 24 full turns or tile bag depleted, sort four scores ascending and compare lexicographically; higher weakest then next weakest wins. Equal draws.
Canal tiles occupy river only; all other tiles occupy land. Exchange replaces your entire hand and costs one action. Tile placement pays after any conflict resolves.
When every board cell is occupied and all conflicts have resolved, the match settles immediately; no further placements are possible.

How to play

Turn two actions: place tile from six-card hand (river color only on river), place/move a leader adjacent to shrine tile, or exchange the entire hand. Tile added to kingdom awards point of its color to same-color leader owner if present. Moving second same-color leader into existing kingdom triggers internal contest using adjacent shrines plus committed shrine hand tiles; loser leader removed. Connecting separate kingdoms containing rival same-color leaders triggers external contest using total matching-color tiles plus committed matching hand cards; loser leader and losing-color tiles removed, potentially splitting kingdom. Tied strength favors defender; commitments simultaneous.
After 24 full turns or tile bag depleted, sort four scores ascending and compare lexicographically; higher weakest then next weakest wins. Equal draws.
Canal tiles occupy river only; all other tiles occupy land. Exchange replaces your entire hand and costs one action. Tile placement pays after any conflict resolves.
When every board cell is occupied and all conflicts have resolved, the match settles immediately; no further placements are possible.
